requirements.Title: NGB Keyed Bottles with High Page Yield
requirements.Description: The Magellan printer must support NGB keyed bottles with 6K Black and 6K CMY page yield. The bottle size for CMY should be greater than 8K.
requirements.Rationale: To meet high page yield demands and provide spill-free reliability for customers, especially in SMB and enterprise segments.
requirements.Stakeholders: R&D, SMB, Enterprise Customers, Product Management
requirements.Dependencies: Bottle design, IDS integration, ink stability modeling.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Given the printer is loaded with NGB keyed bottles, when printing, then it should achieve 6K Black and 6K CMY page yields and CMY bottle size >8K without spills.

requirements.Title: Spill-Free Reliability for Ink Bottles
requirements.Description: The Magellan printer must deliver spill-free reliability during bottle installation and usage, including NOA-F with metal foiled labyrinth and lid label.
requirements.Rationale: To reduce mess and improve customer satisfaction during ink refilling and maintenance.
requirements.Dependencies: NOA-F design, bottle engineering, lid label integration.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Given a user installs a bottle, when ink is transferred, then there should be no spills or leakage.

requirements.Title: NOA-F Service Parts for Warranty Support
requirements.Description: NOA-F components must be available as service parts to support warranty claims within the Magellan printer lifecycle.
requirements.Rationale: To enable effective warranty support and reduce downtime for customers.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Given a warranty claim, when service is performed, then NOA-F parts must be available and replaceable.

requirements.Title: Acumen 6 Integration on Lid
requirements.Description: The printer must integrate Acumen 6 technology on the ink bottle lid for improved reliability and traceability.
requirements.Rationale: To enhance product reliability and enable traceability for service and quality control.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Given a bottle lid, when inspected, then Acumen 6 features must be present and functional.

requirements.Title: Factory Configuration for NOA-F and Ink Cart
requirements.Description: Modify existing SA 14 line for NOA-F and add Magi ink cart and labelling tool in Orcus 5. Mold for 1 to 4 new keyed caps.
requirements.Rationale: To support production of new components and streamline manufacturing.
requirements.Dependencies: SA 14 line, Orcus 5, new cap molds.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Given factory setup, when production starts, then NOA-F, Magi ink cart, and new keyed caps must be produced without bottlenecks.

requirements.Title: Support Customer Replaceable PHA and NOA-F
requirements.Description: The printer must allow customers to replace PHA and NOA-F components easily, reducing service calls and downtime.
requirements.Rationale: To improve serviceability and reduce maintenance costs.
requirements.Stakeholders: End Users, Service Teams, Product Management
requirements.Dependencies: PHA and NOA-F design for user replaceability.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Given a customer needs to replace PHA or NOA-F, when following instructions, then replacement should be possible without technical assistance.

requirements.Title: New Warranty Page Life Goal of 80k Pages
requirements.Description: The Magellan printer must support a new warranty page life goal of 80,000 pages for key components.
requirements.Rationale: To align with customer expectations and competitive benchmarks for durability and reliability.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Given normal usage, when the printer reaches 80k pages, then components should still be within warranty and functional.

requirements.Title: Reddington ID with Tank Size Increase
requirements.Description: The product must use Reddington ID with an increase in tank size to accommodate higher ink volumes. No change to Marconi-HI ADF.
requirements.Rationale: To support higher page yields and reduce refill frequency.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Given the printer design, when inspected, then tank size must be increased and compatible with Reddington ID.

requirements.Title: EPS Foam Packaging
requirements.Description: The Magellan printer must be packaged using EPS foam for improved protection during shipping and handling.
requirements.Rationale: To reduce damage during transit and meet sustainability requirements (EPEAT3, LOT4, Blue Angel for PDL SKU).
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Given packaged printer, when shipped, then EPS foam must protect against damage and meet certification requirements.

requirements.Title: Input and Output Tray Changes to Align with Tank Protrusion
requirements.Description: Input and output trays must be redesigned to accommodate tank protrusion resulting from increased tank size.
requirements.Rationale: To ensure smooth operation and avoid interference with tank design.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Given printer with increased tank, when trays are used, then they must operate without obstruction.

requirements.Title: Size Optimization with 4.3” CGD
requirements.Description: Optimize printer size, including integration of 4.3” CGD display for improved user interface.
requirements.Rationale: To enhance user experience and optimize space utilization.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Given the printer, when powered on, then the 4.3” CGD display must be functional and size optimized.

requirements.Title: Platform with 4 Tubes and New Tube Routing
requirements.Description: Leverage Sayan Sibstar tubes with new tube routing and integration for ink delivery.
requirements.Rationale: To improve ink flow, reliability, and support increased page life.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Given the printer, when printing, then ink must flow reliably through 4 tubes with new routing.

requirements.Title: Service Station Aerosol Management
requirements.Description: Implement aerosol management in the service station with spit platform changes due to tank design.
requirements.Rationale: To reduce ink aerosol emissions and improve environmental safety.
requirements.Dependencies: Service station design, spit platform engineering.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Given service station operation, when in use, then aerosol emissions must be controlled and meet safety standards.

requirements.Title: Carriage Dynamic and Force Model Update
requirements.Description: Update carriage dynamic and force model to account for new tube routing and increased weights from tank changes.
requirements.Rationale: To ensure reliable movement and prevent mechanical failures.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Given carriage operation, when moving, then force model must account for new weights and routing.

requirements.Title: Paperpath Support for Increased Page Life
requirements.Description: Design paperpath to support increased page life and durability for high volume printing.
requirements.Rationale: To ensure reliable operation over extended printer lifetime.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Given printer operation, when printing high volumes, then paperpath must remain reliable and durable.

requirements.Title: Ink Maintenance Serviceable Part Post 80k Life
requirements.Description: Enable ink maintenance as a serviceable part at service centers after 80k page life is reached.
requirements.Rationale: To extend printer life and reduce total cost of ownership for customers.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Given a printer at service center post 80k pages, when serviced, then ink maintenance must be possible and effective.

requirements.Title: 140ml K Bottles and xx ml CMY Bottles
requirements.Description: Support new 140ml Black ink bottles and new CMY bottle sizes for increased yield.
requirements.Rationale: To meet high volume printing needs and reduce refill frequency.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Given new bottles, when installed, then printer must accept 140ml K and xx ml CMY bottles without issues.

requirements.Title: IDS New Make-break and FI Connection
requirements.Description: Implement new make-break and FI (Fluidic Interface) connection in IDS for improved reliability and ease of use.
requirements.Rationale: To reduce maintenance complexity and improve ink delivery system reliability.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Given IDS operation, when connecting/disconnecting, then make-break and FI must be reliable and easy to use.

requirements.Title: LEBI Ink-tank with Increased Size, Keying, and LOI SHAID
requirements.Description: Leverage LEBI ink-tank design with increased size, keying, and LOI SHAID for improved compatibility and security.
requirements.Rationale: To support higher yields and prevent incorrect bottle installation.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Given LEBI tank, when used, then increased size, keying, and SHAID must be functional.

requirements.Title: New IDS Startup Algorithm and Air Management
requirements.Description: Develop new IDS startup algorithm and air management for improved reliability and ink flow.
requirements.Rationale: To prevent startup failures and ensure consistent ink delivery.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Given printer startup, when IDS is initialized, then algorithm must ensure reliable ink flow and air management.

requirements.Title: New Servicing and Startup Algorithm
requirements.Description: Implement new servicing and startup algorithm for improved maintenance and reliability.
requirements.Rationale: To reduce service time and improve printer reliability.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Given printer servicing or startup, when algorithm is executed, then maintenance must be faster and more reliable.

requirements.Title: New PQ Goals and Depletion to Meet Page Yield Definition
requirements.Description: Define new Print Quality (PQ) goals and depletion criteria to meet page yield definition for Magellan printer.
requirements.Rationale: To ensure consistent print quality and align with page yield promises.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Given printing operation, when page yield is reached, then PQ must meet defined standards.

requirements.Title: Reuse Marconi Tux dASIC, Hannibal aASIC, Raccoon PSU
requirements.Description: Reuse Marconi Tux dASIC, Hannibal aASIC, and Raccoon PSU for Magellan printer to optimize cost and development time.
requirements.Rationale: To leverage proven components and reduce investment.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Given printer assembly, when components are reused, then they must function as expected without integration issues.

requirements.Title: Stingray Wi-fi Module Integration
requirements.Description: Integrate Stingray Wi-fi module for wireless connectivity in Magellan printer.
requirements.Rationale: To support modern connectivity requirements for SMB and enterprise customers.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Given printer, when Wi-fi is enabled, then Stingray module must provide reliable wireless connection.

requirements.Title: Dune Firmware Integration
requirements.Description: Integrate Dune firmware for Magellan printer operation and feature support.
requirements.Rationale: To enable advanced features and maintain firmware consistency.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Given printer operation, when firmware is loaded, then Dune must support all required features.

requirements.Title: Gauss4.xx Security (HW & FW)
requirements.Description: Implement Gauss4.xx security for hardware and firmware to protect against threats and ensure data safety.
requirements.Rationale: To meet enterprise security requirements and protect user data.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Given printer operation, when security features are tested, then Gauss4.xx must prevent unauthorized access.

requirements.Title: EPEAT3, LOT4, Blue Angel Certification for PDL SKU
requirements.Description: Ensure Magellan printer meets EPEAT3, LOT4, and Blue Angel certification requirements for PDL SKU.
requirements.Rationale: To align with sustainability goals and regulatory requirements.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Given printer SKU, when audited, then it must pass EPEAT3, LOT4, and Blue Angel certifications.

requirements.Title: Support Multiple Business Models and Solutions
requirements.Description: Magellan printer must support consumer, SMB, and enterprise business models, including PaaS, WorkFromHome/Flexworker, onboarding paths (Consumer/HPX, HP One, SMB Portal, ECP), and solutions (Scan, SMB manageability, Enterprise support: WJA, HPSM, JAM).
requirements.Rationale: To maximize market reach and address diverse customer needs.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Given deployment, when business model is selected, then printer must support relevant solutions and onboarding paths.

requirements.Title: Client & Driver Support
requirements.Description: Magellan printer must support HPX, PSA, SUPD, UPD, EasyStart, USS, and UFD clients and drivers for broad compatibility.
requirements.Rationale: To ensure ease of installation and operation across various customer environments.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Given printer installation, when drivers are loaded, then all listed clients and drivers must be supported and functional.

requirements.Title: Schedule Adherence (Q325-Q427)
requirements.Description: Adhere to the defined schedule for hardware, NOA-F, and bottle checkpoints, and builds (Imech, BB1, BB2, TR, LP1, LP2, MP1/PP, SOR).
requirements.Rationale: To ensure timely delivery and meet market launch targets.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Given project timeline, when checkpoints are reached, then schedule must be adhered to as defined.

requirements.Title: SuperAmp PHA Life at 65K Pages
requirements.Description: SuperAmp PHA component must support life of at least 65,000 pages before replacement.
requirements.Rationale: To ensure durability and reduce maintenance frequency.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Given printer operation, when SuperAmp PHA reaches 65K pages, then it must remain functional without failure.

requirements.Title: Warranty Life of Pages (2 Years)
requirements.Description: Magellan printer must offer warranty life of pages for at least 2 years.
requirements.Rationale: To increase customer confidence and align with competitive standards.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Given printer purchase, when warranty is claimed within 2 years, then coverage must be provided for page life.

requirements.Title: Throughput of 25/20 PPM (PDL)
requirements.Description: Magellan printer must achieve throughput of 25 pages per minute (ppm) and 20 ppm for PDL.
requirements.Rationale: To meet productivity requirements for SMB and enterprise users.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Given printing operation, when tested, then throughput must reach 25/20 ppm as defined.

requirements.Title: Serviceability (Maintenance Box)
requirements.Description: Magellan printer must provide easy serviceability, including maintenance box for quick access and servicing.
requirements.Rationale: To reduce maintenance time and improve customer satisfaction.
requirements.Stakeholders: Service Teams, End Users, Product Management
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Given printer maintenance, when box is accessed, then service must be performed easily and efficiently.

requirements.Title: SMB Solution Support
requirements.Description: Magellan printer must offer SMB solution features for manageability and productivity.
requirements.Rationale: To address SMB customer needs and differentiate from competitors.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Given SMB deployment, when solution is used, then manageability features must be functional.

requirements.Title: PaaS (Print as a Service) Schedule Support
requirements.Description: Magellan printer must be compatible with PaaS business model and schedule requirements.
requirements.Rationale: To enable flexible business offerings and align with market trends.
requirements.Stakeholders: Product Management, Sales, SMB, Enterprise Customers
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Given PaaS deployment, when schedule is followed, then printer must support business model requirements.

requirements.Title: Host 12K-CMYK Capability (Flexible Priority)
requirements.Description: Magellan printer should be capable of hosting 12K CMYK page yields, subject to flexible prioritization.
requirements.Rationale: To address future high volume needs and allow flexibility in product roadmap.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Given printer upgrade, when tested, then 12K CMYK hosting must be possible if prioritized.

requirements.Title: Trade Page 6K (Flexible Priority)
requirements.Description: Magellan printer should support trade page yield of 6K, allowing flexibility in prioritization.
requirements.Rationale: To address market trade segment needs with flexible prioritization.
requirements.Dependencies: Page yield modeling, ink system design.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Given trade segment deployment, when tested, then 6K trade page yield must be achievable if prioritized.
